label: preparing
what: Apparently coordinated preparations for the day 1 eighteen o'clock great-hall baking and hospitality presentation, involving bread supplied through the bakery and inn. The innkeeper has disclosed the presentation but not its detailed preparations; reports connect baker, innkeeper and neighbour at the bakery. The neighbour's participation is less certain. Secretary knowingly helps by scheduling the presentation; no evidence she knows any undisclosed purpose. No clear evidence of a separate secret event.
